d: The Kalos League rages on toward the semifinals, and the red-hot battling never ceases to excite and amaze!
The semifinals of the Kalos League have arrived, bringing two intense battles!
As the Kalos League semifinal round continues between Ash and Sawyer, the audience witnesses a rivalry few have ever experienced!

st: Kalos League Passion With A Certain Flare!
d: The final round of the Kalos League is about to get under way, and there’s a lot going on behind the scenes!
It’s time for the Kalos League finals, and it’s Ash versus Alain in their much-anticipated battle!
The final round of the Kalos League is in high gear, and surprises are in abundance, from the first second to the very last!
Lysandre and Team Flare are attempting to take over Lumiose City and the world. Our heroes are in the middle of the chaos!
Lumiose City is on the verge of ruin, but our heroes and their friends are not about to stand by and do nothing!

st: The Right Hero For The Right Job!
d: The fate of Kalos and the world depends on the outcome of Team Flare’s plans, and our heroes are doing their best to stop them!
The fate of Chespie and the world rests in the hands of an extraordinarily powerful group of friends and allies!
The moment of truth has arrived, as our heroes and their friends must face the final challenge that will decide the fate of the world!
The Lumiose City Gym is still being repaired, but a battle challenge from a young Trainer is just the thing to get everyone and everything up and running!

st: The First Day Of The Rest Of Your Life!
d: Our heroes are busy planning their futures, but one is having more trouble planning than the others!

st: Facing The Needs Of The Many!
d: As our heroes prepare to go their separate ways, they face the return of a danger that wasn’t quite defeated!
Our heroes are going their separate ways, and it’s time for goodbyes, fond memories, and eyes to the future!

st: The Legend Of X, Y, And Z!
d: A trip to some newly discovered ruins in Kalos reveals a rich history of compassion and caring from three Legendary Pokémon!
What begins as a vacation for our hero on Melemele Island in the Alola region turns into the promise of many, many exciting adventures to come!
Ash and Pikachu are adjusting to life in the Alola region and it’s about to give them a powerful push in a new direction!
Ash’s journey in the Alola region is just getting under way, and our hero has a new partner to share it with!
Ash is after his first Pokémon in the Alola region, and the adventure that ensues is typical Ash!
Ash’s Pokémon class is off to the sea for some fishing, but Team Rocket has a completely different kind of fishing in mind!
Ash’s first day off from Pokémon School was supposed to be a relaxing break, but things don’t go quite as expected!

st: That's Why the Litten is a Scamp!
d: A feisty Litten is determined to steal food from others, and Ash and Pikachu are determined to find out why!
Lillie has a Pokémon Egg to care for until it hatches, but will fear get in her way?
Ash wants a new Z-Crystal, but he must face some formidable tasks first!
The Melemele Island grand trial is imminent, and Ash must square off against the power and wisdom of Kahuna Hala!
Ash has time off from school for training, but a fellow student’s activities away from school have our hero wanting to find out all about it!

st: The Sun, The Scare, The Secret Lair!
d: While our heroes enjoy a class on the beach, familiar and unfamiliar troubles are brewing behind the scenes!
An Alolan tradition whets everyone’s appetite for fun, and Ash decides to join in!
The time has come for Lillie to address her fears, and having a new friend is the perfect way to do it!
Rockruff’s current behavior may be a mystery, but Ash and Professor Kukui are determined to get to the bottom of it!
Team Rocket has their eyes on our heroes’ Pokémon, but a mysterious third Pokémon has a different idea!
There’s a mystery that needs solving, and there’s also a surprising sleuth who’s determined to solve it!
Our heroes are hungry indeed, but a quest to find the missing ingredient is keeping them that way!
Ash is looking for a very important rematch, and his training regimen is breaking new ground!
A pleasant day trip for our heroes turns into an unforgettable adventure!
The ending of one chapter in the life of a determined Pokémon ushers in the beginning of a brand-new one!
A day at the beach offers up our heroes much more than they bargained for!
A major force in Alolan popular music is in the verge of collapse!
